newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse index up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse index up slightly.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius Semdex index edged up by 0.26 points on Wednesday to 379.68 with rises in hotel and transport sector shares, bourse officials said.
Volume transacted rose to 4.47 million rupees on 203,553 shares from 3.87 million rupees on 256,882 shares on Monday.
"There has been buying interest on hotel stocks from foreign investors during to-day's session," one broker said.

Sun Resorts climbed 40 cents to 48.00 rupees on 14,100 shares, Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) gained 1.00 rupee to 53.00 rupees on 5,745 shares and New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) was stable at 38.00 rupees on 11,350 shares.

In the transport sector, Air Mauritius rose 30 cents to 35.30 rupees on 650 shares. Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) was unchanged to 89.00 rupees on 2,473 shares and State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) also was stable at 13.00 rupees on 83,600 shares.
Commerce-based conglomerates Ireland Blyth Ltd eased 20 cents to 15.40 rupees on 1,000 shares and Rogers fell 50 cents to 91.50 rupees on 1,100 shares.
In the sugar sector, Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) lost 40 cents to 38.10 rupees on 11,251 shares and Mon Desert Alma (MDA) (O) was 2.00 rupees lower to 80.00 rupees on 300 shares.
Industry stock Mauritius Breweries Ltd (MBL) rose 2.00 rupees to 154.00 rupees on 1,717 shares.
